notes.title: 1.5 Version
notes.content:
1. Updated DLC: Girls' Dormitory. You can enter the DLC in the upper right corner of the game start scene. This chapter is an independent puzzle game with high difficulty. Please make good use of all objects in the scene!
2. Fixed bugs
1.更新DLC：女生宿舍。在游戏开始界面的右上角可以进入DLC游玩。该章节为独立的解谜游戏，难度很高，请利用好场景里的一切物体！
2.修复bug

notes.title: New Content - 新内容预告
notes.content:
A new puzzle dlc : Girls Dormitory is expected to be updated at the end of the month. This chapter will tell a funny and enjoyable story.
新的解谜DLC：女生宿舍预计会在月底更新，该章节会讲述一段轻松愉快的故事。

notes.title: 说明
notes.content:
When the graphic quality is the lowest, the item inspection window may display abnormally. If any player encounters this situation, please temporarily adjust the image quality to a higher level.

在最低画质下会出现检视物品显示异常的问题，如有玩家遇到此情况请暂时先将画面质量调高一个档位。

notes.title: Update Notes (2024/12/29)
notes.content:
1. Added difficulty selection, which can be set on the start interface
2. Chapter 3 can now be played directly

1.可在开始界面选择难度
2.第三章现在可直接游玩

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
Due to ambiguity, the mobile phone password in Chapter 3 now supports two answers
由于存在歧义，第三章的手机密码现在支持两个答案

notes.title: 1.2 Update Notes
notes.content:
Reduced the difficulty of the first two chapters
Bug fix
